name: Khazrak the One-Eye
canonNotes: The most cunning Beastlord of the Drakwald, who lost an eye to Boris Todbringer and swore endless vengeance on Middenland.
Unusually strategic for a beast, he plans raids and ambushes with cold intelligence.
voiceNotes: Snarling but calculating; hatred of civilisation, especially Middenland and Todbringer.
Views treaties as tools; respects cunning and strength.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
